scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('woodcraftpro-frontend')){ cp.execSync('cd woodcraftpro-frontend && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); try{ fs.cpSync('woodcraftpro-frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }catch(e){} }else{ cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
